entities.name: Abd-al-Dar ibn Qusai
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Abd-al-Dar ibn Qusai forms an important link between his father, Qusai ibn Kilab, the great-great-grandfather of Shaiba ibn Hashim (Abdul-Mutallib) and his own sons Uthman and Abd Manaf, since he is the progenitor of the Banu Abd-al-dar.
